pancakes.txt.content:
Ingredients are flour, milk, eggs, sugar, and butter. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
Heat a pan
Pour a small amount of the mixture into the pan
Cook until golden brown
Serve with syrup.

scrambled_eggs.txt.content:
Ingredients are eggs, butter, and salt. Crack the eggs into a bowl
Whisk until the yolks and whites are mixed
Melt butter in a pan over low heat
Pour in the eggs and stir gently
Take the pan off the heat while they are still slightly soft
Serve right away.

pasta.txt.content:
Ingredients are pasta, salt, olive oil, garlic, and tomatoes. Boil a pot of salted water
Cook the pasta until tender
Warm olive oil in a pan and cook the garlic briefly
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer
Drain the pasta and toss it with the sauce
Serve with a little more olive oil.

grilled_cheese.txt.content:
Ingredients are bread, cheese, and butter. Butter one side of each slice of bread
Place cheese between the slices, buttered sides out
Heat a pan over medium heat
Cook until the bread is golden and the cheese melts
Flip once
Serve while it is still hot.

oatmeal.txt.content:
Ingredients are oats, milk, salt, and honey. Pour milk into a small pot
Stir in the oats and a pinch of salt
Simmer, stirring, until the oats are soft
Take the pot off the heat
Sweeten with honey
Serve warm.

french_toast.txt.content:
Ingredients are bread, eggs, milk, cinnamon, and butter. Whisk the eggs, milk, and cinnamon in a bowl
Dip each slice of bread in the mixture
Melt butter in a pan
Cook the bread until both sides are golden
Serve with a little extra cinnamon.

tomato_soup.txt.content:
Ingredients are tomatoes, onion, garlic, broth, and salt. Chop the onion and garlic
Cook them in a pot until soft
Add chopped tomatoes and broth
Simmer until the tomatoes break down
Blend until smooth
Season with salt and serve.

rice.txt.content:
Ingredients are rice, water, and salt. Rinse the rice
Add it to a pot with water and a pinch of salt
Bring the water to a boil
Cover and simmer until the water is absorbed
Let it rest off the heat
Fluff with a fork and serve.

guacamole.txt.content:
Ingredients are avocado, lime, onion, salt, and tomato. Cut the avocado in half and scoop it into a bowl
Mash it with a fork
Stir in chopped onion and tomato
Squeeze in lime juice
Add salt
Serve right away.

hot_chocolate.txt.content:
Ingredients are milk, cocoa powder, and sugar. Warm the milk in a small pot
Whisk in the cocoa powder and sugar
Keep whisking until it is smooth and hot
Do not let it boil
Pour into a mug and serve.
